mapper.select: SELECT id, title, author, price, total_quantity, deleted, version FROM books WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT b.id, b.title, b.author, b.price, b.total_quantity, b.deleted, b.version, COUNT(r.id) AS unreturned_quantity FROM books AS b LEFT JOIN borrow_records AS r ON b.id = r.book_id AND r.returned_at IS NULL WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.id = #{id} GROUP BY b.id, b.title, b.author, b.price, b.total_quantity, b.deleted, b.version

SELECT b.id, b.title, b.author, b.price, b.total_quantity, b.deleted, b.version, COUNT(r.id) AS unreturned_quantity FROM books AS b LEFT JOIN borrow_records AS r ON b.id = r.book_id AND r.returned_at IS NULL WHERE b.deleted = 0 GROUP BY b.id, b.title, b.author, b.price, b.total_quantity, b.deleted, b.version ORDER BY b.id ASC

SELECT b.id, b.title, b.author, b.price, b.total_quantity, b.deleted, b.version, COUNT(r.id) AS unreturned_quantity FROM books AS b LEFT JOIN borrow_records AS r ON b.id = r.book_id AND r.returned_at IS NULL WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND LOWER(b.title) LIKE LOWER(#{keyword}) ESCAPE '!' GROUP BY b.id, b.title, b.author, b.price, b.total_quantity, b.deleted, b.version ORDER BY b.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO books (title, author, price, total_quantity) VALUES (#{title}, #{author}, #{price}, #{totalQuantity})
mapper.update: UPDATE books SET title = #{title}, author = #{author}, price = #{price}, total_quantity = #{totalQuantity}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND version = #{expectedVersion}
